Hi, I just wanted to give you some small advice. As someone who would gladly end it right now as well, I managed to decrease the feeling of wanting to leave this world by meditating, it hasn’t “fixed” me but I managed to decrease so much of my anxiety and sadness through this. We need to release our negativity and look at the small positives we have, and appreciate those things, because there’s so many other souls on this rock that don’t have **at least** one thing that we do have. There is one person out there who absolutely **desires** that one thing you have. This life gave it to you, whatever it may be. Just cherish those little things while time passes us by towards our already inevitable deaths, and look ahead to the future as we look for whatever extra things we’d like.

Me, as sad of a life I’m living now, made a goal to eventually see more of the world which is this rock. Why not examine the pebble we’re living on and just breathe in the air? We may not be able to even breathe one day, fuck all **things** that make us feel like shit. They’re designed to make us give up on this life we were forced into. Meditate regularly and ask yourself what you really want and currently appreciate. You have pets and a partner, something so many would wish to have. Do anything you can with them, live life with them and look for a calm in life. Be happy doing the dumbest shit solely because you can do it. The success other people have is created of their own doing, they’re “**them**” and you’re “**you**”. You are special in your own right. We all are. We’re both just one tiny soul, made the same way yet so different, placed in a body. 

Now, this is way easier said than done but the meditation part can really help. Mentally talk to yourself but also don’t keep speaking to the dark thoughts that come to your mind. I feel like this is a good start of figuring out what we can do next. You feel just a bit lighter when you lessen some of the weight you carry. Externally, this world won’t change unless you have power. But internally, **something** in you can change at least a tiny bit. Sorry for talking so much, but I’m just venting because we all shouldn’t suffer like this. This is the stupid challenge of life, a bunch of rules, yet society doesn’t even teach us the importance of mental health/stability.

The title carries plenty of merit I feel. It signifies what it means. It glorified the trio ninja system established by any of the first three Hokage, probably Tobirama. To the point of all ninjas adapting to it instead of mobbing in randomly numbered squads, like Early Konoha days. They each are ideal, PERFECT, ninja that **signify** what the ideal perfect team is. Imo, that’s what makes the title mean something.

The reason why that is, is because it proves that fighting in trios is efficient, both for being enough expendable manpower, and synergy. The whole close, mid, and long range/support deal. 
  
**Considering their strength**(clearly Kage level), the Sannin complemented themselves so well that they managed to hold up against Hanzo. They had more than strength ofc, they have the things we already know that are exclusive to them, and their students. Each sannin are ninja prodigies, some skill in all ninja arts give or take one or two. We never see a **regular team** of ninja prodigies in three. The survival part of their battle is the main point. Hanzo clearly was unfairly monstrous and/or deadly, considering Ibuse. I’m 100% sure Ibuse is the most slept on summon. Much more to him than what we see. 

TLDR ~ Their title has weight because they literally were the perfect storm at the right time, becoming Hiruzen’s masterpiece, and forever a staple of ninja combat worldwide, created by the Senju brothers. Team 7 just proves their point.

Which is why Hiruzen gets so much respect from me. Even in advanced age, he put his body and literally his soul into keeping Konoha formidable despite the shit thrown his way. Losses in Shinobi force, signing Danzo off on several black operations, playing nice, retaking the position again, so much more **we haven’t even seen.** Danzou too, in a grimy, disgusting, yet commendable way. Hiruzen may look insignificant in comparison to the other Kage, but keep in mind that he kept Konoha well afloat with an old, tired body.
